shared_elements: low-relief human figures (partial, in profile orientation)
clothed figures with garment/drapery indicated by lines
horizontal dividing line separating zones or registers
a row of repeated small motifs along a band
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief clothed human figures with hands holding objects, organised into horizontally stacked zones divided by a straight line, with a band of repeated small motifs (a row of rosettes in B, rows of offering signs in A) — but these are generic conventions of register-based relief. The specific content differs entirely: A depicts seated and standing figures flanking a laden offering table with columns of small pictographic signs, while B shows only the lower body/drapery of a large striding figure above a rosette frieze, with no seated figure, no offering table and no sign columns.
